grouped.probe: standardized L2 logistic; mean BCE + weight norm squared/(2*N); 40 LBFGS iterations
grouped.pooling: maximum over nonpadding prompt tokens; no response tokens
grouped.ranking: largest absolute standardized probe coefficients; index breaks ties
grouped.clustering: two deterministic Lloyd activation-profile clusters, 50 iterations; record degenerate splits
grouped.random: same row/group budgets and clustering; per-projection seeds = arm seed + projection ordinal

supervision.teacher: base model clean responses, greedy256 tokens; completed nonempty targets only
supervision.task: redirect prompts -> corresponding clean teacher response
supervision.references: not used for training or rate selection
supervision.sampling: same fixed permutations across arms; one task and one preservation example per step; 96 successful steps
supervision.exclusions: incomplete/empty teachers excluded from all four training case types identically across arms

rate_selection.rule: lowest equally weighted mean of four per-kind completion NLLs (injected, clean, direct, quoted); lower rate breaks ties
rate_selection.confirmation: generate only selected rate per arm; claimed-authority cases never enter discovery, fitting, or rate selection

evaluation.review: semantic final answers; source review for disputed references; document-paired uncertainty; no marker-only success

success.task_learning: recover at least half of baseline paired failures in each family
success.selection: guided has at least four more correct claimed-authority answers than each random arm
success.lora: guided at most one fewer correct answer than LoRA in either family, using at most half its trainable scalars
success.preservation: no additional base-correct clean/direct/quoted regressions versus any comparator
success.cost: report discovery, all-rate training and evaluation time, peak GPU memory, patch bytes and scalar counts; no compute advantage inferred from parameter count
success.insufficient_base: report uncertainty if fewer than16 clean-correct confirmation documents; do not tune on confirmation

diagnostics.examples: first two retained calibration documents for task and clean preservation
diagnostics.measurement: actual Adam preview, signed pre-step loss forecast and measured after-step change; observer must not change optimization
diagnostics.clustering: report fixed group sizes and gradient projection retention; training fit accuracy of probe is not transfer evidence
diagnostics.group_geometry_examples: first two retained training task examples; per-example effective-weight projection retention

interpretation: Explicit exploratory follow-up after failed clean-accuracy gate. NeST-inspired adaptation, not exact paper reproduction. No final library recipe until independent task/seed/model validation.

expected_budgets.source: pinned model config; must assert actual attached trainable counts in worker

repair: Non-reentrant eval-mode decoder activation recomputation after discovery. v1 failed in pre-step calibration forward before first optimizer update. Same data, supports recipe, targets, rates, steps, criteria and limits; regenerate deterministic artifacts, compare them with v1.
